description.to:
Outcome: A full dress rehearsal with no reader impact. Steps: (1) run copy-backend --stamp-tenant threat-intelligence from TI's backend (amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms in papyrus-production; TI rows carry no tenant today) into the staging shared stack, dry run first; (2) convert TI's web/projection.json and brand into SiteConfig and BrandPack (PPY-1252ce); (3) copy the Cyclotron store and monitor configuration; (4) project the tenant; (5) compare every URL of the live site with the staging tenant's (the PPY-bcfd2d parity method and src/papyrus_content/projection/url_compare.py: status, normalised DOM, head metadata, sitemap URL set, redirects, feeds); (6) run the adversarial suite with TI and the staging test tenant. Writes nothing to TI's production backend.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): copy-backend (docs/migrations/copy-backend.md), src/papyrus_content/projection/url_compare.py, Threat-Intelligence repo web/projection.json and publication/brand (read), the staging shared stack.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/ti-shared-rehearsal.feature):
Scenario: The staging tenant matches the live TI site
    Given TI copied into the staging shared stack
    When every live URL is compared with the staging tenant
    Then differences are only the allow-listed ones, each with a reason

Scenario: The copy is complete
    When copy-backend runs a second time
    Then it creates, updates and copies nothing

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-8f9462, PPY-413576, PPY-3bbbf9, PPY-bdc4ee. Blocks PPY-e51189, PPY-0c4b55. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-32b4c5.

Testing: Parity report attached to this issue.
Rollout: Staging only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: TI's own art (pictograms) has no place in the preset. Mitigation: still pictograms through the image-style slot (PPY-9c4af5) must be done first, listed in the parity allow-list otherwise.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
